wiki.extract: Kristey Williams (born October 16, 1970) is an American politician who has served in the Kansas House of Representatives from the 77th district since 2015. She is a Republican.In 2026, Wiliams spoke in support of a Kansas House bill which would outlaw the teaching of "DEI," (Diversity, Equity and Inclusion) and "CRT," (Critical Race Theory) in Kansas universities.
